name: GATA binding protein 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: GATA1 encodes erythroid transcription factor. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to GATA1-related cytopenia (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
